import FreeCAD
import Part
import PartDesign

# Open the precondition file
doc = FreeCAD.open("/home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd")

sketch = doc.getObject("Sketch")
body = doc.getObject("Body")

print(f"Body: {body.Name}")

body.setEdit()

# Create an Additive Helix
# In FreeCAD, the AdditiveHelix is created via PartDesign::AdditiveHelix
helix = doc.addObject("PartDesign::AdditiveHelix", "AdditiveHelix")

helix.Axis = "X"  # Along X-axis
helix.Turns = 4
helix.Pitch = 30.0
helix.ConeAngle = 0.0

print(f"  Pitch: {helix.Pitch}")
